#Region "Main"
    COMMENT  Nested structures test
    LOOP FOREACH Item IN %ItemList%
        IF %Item% > 10
            LOOP FOREACH SubItem IN %SubItemList%
                IF %SubItem% = %Item%
                    COMMENT  Deep nesting found
                    Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Match found: %Item%'''
                END
            END
        ELSE
            COMMENT  Item is small
            SET SmallItem TO %Item%
        END
    END
    ON BLOCK ERROR
        LOOP FOREACH Retry IN %RetryList%
            COMMENT  Retry logic
            Variables.SetVariable NewValue: %Retry% Name: CurrentRetry
        END
    END
#EndRegion
